The root cause of the error is that we are trying to call `.sum()` on a boolean Series that was created from a DataFrame slice, but we are not properly extracting the count. The correct way is to use `.sum()` on a boolean Series to get the count of `True` values.

We will fix the code by ensuring we are working with a boolean Series and using `.sum()` correctly.
